candidates.label: Prophetic lineage and continuous guidance-chain: eighteen prophets enumerated across generations from Nuh to Isa; hujjah given Ibrahim; chose guided straight path; if associated would void deeds; scripture wisdom prophethood entrusted non-disbelieving successors
candidates.definition: In 6:83-89: That was Our argument We gave Ibrahim against his people. We raise degrees whom We will. Your Lord is Wise Knowing. We gave him Ishaq and Yaqub each We guided. And Nuh We guided before. From his offspring Dawud Sulayman Ayyub Yusuf Musa Harun. Thus We reward doers of good. And Zakariyya Yahya Isa Elias all of the righteous. And Ismail Alyasa Yunus Lut each We preferred over the worlds. From their fathers offspring brothers We chose and guided to straight path. If they had associated it would have been voided for them. Those We gave scripture wisdom prophethood. If these disbelieve We entrusted it to people not disbelieving.

evidence.excerpt: وَتِلۡكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦۚ نَرۡفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٖ مَّن نَّشَآءُۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Watilka hujjatuna ataynaha ibraheema AAala qawmihi narfaAAu darajatin man nashao inna rabbaka hakeemun AAaleemun: divine hujjah as conclusive argument establishing prophetic authority derived from God not social consensus.

evidence.excerpt: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَۚ كُلًّا هَدَيۡنَاۚ وَنُوحًا هَدَيۡنَا مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba kullan hadayna wanoohan hadayna min qablu wamin thurriyyatihi dawooda wasulaymana waayyooba wayoosufa wamoosa waharoona wakathalika najzee almuhsineena: six descendants plus Nuh establishing pre-Abrahamic continuity.

evidence.excerpt: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحۡيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلۡيَاسَۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wazakariyya wayahya waAAeesa wailyasa kullun mina alssaliheena: second group spanning priestly (Zakariyya-Yahya) messianic (Isa) and prophetic (Elias) roles.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطٗاۚ وَكُلّٗا فَضَّلۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: WaismaAAeela wailyasaAAa wayoonusa walootan wakullan faddalna AAala alAAalameena: third group including Arabian-line (Ismail) and non-Israelite (Lut) prophets demonstrating universality.

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَلَوۡ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَحَبِطَ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao min AAibadihi walaw ashrakoo lahabita AAanhum ma kanoo yaAAmaloona: shirk-nullification clause establishing conditionality of all prophetic achievement.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَۚ فَإِن يَكۡفُرۡ بِهَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدۡ وَكَّلۡنَا بِهَا قَوۡمٗا لَّيۡسُواْ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Olaika allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata fain yakfur biha haolai faqad wakkalna biha qawman laysoo biha bikafireena: scripture-wisdom-prophethood triad with succession-safeguard ensuring message persistence.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Comprehensive prophetic enumeration establishing continuity and universality
Ibrahim as anchor-point of prophetic chain receiving divine hujjah

candidates.urduLabel: السلالة النبوية وسلسلة الهداية المتصلة: ثمانية عشر نبياً من نوح إلى عيسى؛ الحجة الممنوحة لإبراهيم؛ اصطفاء وهداية إلى صراط مستقيم؛ الشرك يبطل الأعمال؛ الكتاب والحكمة والنبوة مؤتمنة عند قوم غير كافرين
candidates.notes: Overlap with prophets and ibrahim-story. Eighteen-prophet enumeration spans three distinct groups demonstrating both genealogical connection and functional diversity. Nuh-placement before Ibrahim establishes pre-Abrahamic monotheism. Shirk-nullification (6:88) prevents prophet-veneration from becoming independent salvation-mechanism. Succession-safeguard (6:89) addresses historical reality of community apostasy while guaranteeing message-survival. This passage functions as canonical prophet-list providing authoritative reference for subsequent Islamic prophetology.

candidates.label: Security-injustice linkage and wage-free reminder: believed did not mix belief injustice have security guided; follow their guidance ask no wage reminder for worlds
candidates.definition: In 6:82,90: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice those will have security and they are guided. Those are the ones whom Allah has guided so from their guidance take an example. Say I ask of you for this message no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يَلۡبِسُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلۡمٍ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡنُ وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
evidence.rationale: Allatheena amanoo walam yalbisoo eemanahum bithulmin olaika lahumu alamnu wahum muhtadoona: faith-zulm separation producing dual outcome of existential security and right-guidance.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُۖ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقۡتَدِهۡۗ قُل لَّآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًاۖ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Olaika allatheena hada Allahu fabihudahumu iqtadih qul la asalukum AAalayhi ajran in huwa illa thikra lilAAalameena: prophetic-following command combined with wage-free universal reminder distinguishing revelation from commerce.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Security as experiential outcome of pure tawheed unmixed with zulm
Zulm-avoidance as taqwa-expression producing existential peace

candidates.urduLabel: الأمن والظلم والتذكير المجاني: الذين آمنوا ولم يلبسوا إيمانهم بظلم لهم الأمن وهم مهتدون؛ اتبعوا هداهم لا أجر إلا ذكرى للعالمين
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed and god-consciousness. Amn-security here differs from political safety denoting existential peace arising from belief-integrity. Zulm-exclusion prevents faith from becoming tribal identity-marker divorced from ethical substance. Wage-free declaration (la asalukum ajran) protects prophetic credibility against commercial suspicion. Dhikra lilAAalameena universalizes message beyond immediate audience. Together these verses define authentic faith as producing both internal security and external accessibility.

candidates.label: Failed divine-appraisal and Mosaic Book counter-proof: did not value Allah true value said Allah revealed nothing human; say who revealed Book Musa light guidance people make parchments display conceal taught what neither you nor fathers knew
candidates.definition: In 6:91: And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal when they said Allah did not reveal to a human being anything. Say who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You make it into pages disclosing some and concealing much. And you were taught that which you knew not neither you nor your fathers. Say Allah. Then leave them in their discourse amusing themselves.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا قَدَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدۡرِهِۦٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٖ مِّن شَيۡءٖۗ قُلۡ مَنۡ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلنَّاسِۖ تَجۡعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبۡدُونَهَا وَتُخۡفُونَ كَثِيرٗاۖ وَعُلِّمۡتُم مَّا لَمۡ تَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنتُمۡ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمۡۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ ثُمَّ ذَرۡهُمۡ فِي خَوۡضِهِمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi ith qaloo ma anzala Allahu AAala basharin min shayin: failed-appraisal diagnosed as root cause of revelation-denial not mere intellectual disagreement. Qul man anzala alkitaba allathee jaa bihi moosa nooran wahudan lilnnasi: Mosaic Book invoked as undeniable counter-proof since opponents themselves accept Torah. TajAAaloonahu qarateesa tubdoonaha watukhfoona katheeran: selective disclosure exposing textual manipulation undermining claim to faithful transmission. WaAAullimtum ma lam taAAlamoo antum wala abaokum: novel-knowledge argument proving revelation transcends ancestral tradition.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Underestimation of divine capacity as root of revelation-denial
Musa as proof-text for human-revelation possibility

candidates.urduLabel: عدم التقدير الحق لله وحجة كتاب موسى: ما قدروا الله حق قدره إذ قالوا ما أنزل الله على بشر من شيء؛ قل من أنزل الكتاب الذي جاء به موسى نوراً وهدى للناس تجعلونه قراطيس تبدونها وتخفون كثيراً وعلمتم ما لم تعلموا أنتم ولا آباؤكم
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed and prophets. Haqqa qadrihi (true appraisal) implies Allah's capacity exceeds human estimation making revelation-denial a failure of imagination not evidence. Mosaic Book serves as internal critique: opponents accept Torah yet deny Quran creating inconsistency. Parchment-display concealing much exposes selective hermeneutics. Novel-knowledge argument breaks ancestral-authority monopoly opening epistemic space for new revelation. Khawdihim yalAAaboona dismissal refuses engagement with bad-faith argumentation.

candidates.label: Death-throes scene and individual return: wrongdoers in death-pangs angels extending hands discharge souls today recompensed humiliation for falsehood arrogance; come individually created first left behind bestowed no intercessors severed lost fabricated
candidates.definition: In 6:93-94: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or says it has been inspired to me while nothing has been inspired to him. And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands saying discharge your souls. Today you will be awarded the punishment of humiliation for what you used to say against Allah other than the truth and you were toward His verses being arrogant. And you have certainly come to Us alone as We created you the first time and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your intercessors which you claimed. It has been severed between you and lost from you is what you used to claim.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوۡ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمۡ يُوحَ إِلَيۡهِ شَيۡءٞ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثۡلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُۗ وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِي غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓاْ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ أَخۡرِجُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمُۖ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ عَذَابَ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيۡرَ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَكُنتُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Walaw tara ithi alththalimoona fee ghamarati almawti waalmalaikatu basitoo aydeehim akhrijoo anfusakumu alyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum taqooloona AAala Allahi ghayra alhaqqi wakuntum AAan ayatihi tastakbiroona: death-throes visualization making abstract accountability sensorially immediate with angelic soul-extraction and humiliation-punishment linked to falsehood-arrogance.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖ وَتَرَكۡتُم مَّا خَوَّلۡنَٰكُمۡ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمۡۖ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمۡ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ فِيكُمۡ شُرَكَـٰٓؤُاْۚ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Walaqad jitumoona furada kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin wataraktum ma khawwalnakum waraa thuhoorikum wama nara maAAakum shufaAAaakumu allatheena zaAAamtum annahum feekum shurakao laqad taqattaAAa baynakum wadalla AAankum ma kuntum tazAAumoona: individual-return mirroring original creation stripping social identity and worldly possessions severing claimed intercessors.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Vivid eschatological scene with soul-extraction and intercessor-severance
Individual accountability eliminating all intermediaries

candidates.urduLabel: مشهد سكرات الموت والرجوع الفردي: الظالمون في غمرات الموت والملائكة باسطو أيديهم أخرجوا أنفسكم اليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما قلتم على الله غير الحق واستكبرتم عن آياته؛ جئتمونا فرادى كما خلقناكم أول مرة وتركتم ما خولناكم وراء ظهوركم لا شفعاء تقطع بينكم وضل ما تزعمون
candidates.notes: Overlap with day-of-judgment and the-hereafter. Ghamarati almawti (overwhelming pangs) provides most visceral death-description in this section. Angelic hand-extension (basitoo aydeehim) physicalizes soul-extraction process. AAathaba alhooni (humiliation punishment) specifically targets false-claim and sign-arrogance linking punishment-form to sin-type. Furada-individuality mirrors awwala marratin (first creation) establishing ontological symmetry between birth and judgment. ShufaAAa-severance demonstrates practical nullification of intercession-doctrine at moment of need.

candidates.label: Biological and cosmic signs of divine agency: Allah splits grain date-stone brings living dead dead from living; Originator daybreak night rest sun moon calculation; stars guide darknesses land sea; single soul origin dwelling storage; rain produces growth greenery grains palm clusters grape olive pomegranate look fruit ripening signs believe; exalted above offspring-fabrication
candidates.definition: In 6:95-100: Indeed Allah is the cleaver of grain and date seeds. He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. That is Allah so how are you deluded? Cleaver of daybreak made night for rest sun and moon for calculation. That is determination of the Exalted Knowing. He placed stars to guide through darknesses of land and sea. Produced you from one soul with dwelling and storage. Sent down water from sky produced growth of all things greenery grains arranged palm clusters gardens of grapevines olives pomegranates similar yet varied. Look at its fruit when it yields and ripening. Indeed in that are signs for people who believe. They attributed partners jinn while He created them fabricated sons daughters without knowledge. Exalted is He above what they describe.

evidence.excerpt: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلۡحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰۖ يُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَمُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Inna Allaha faliqu alhabbi waalnnawa yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wamukhriju almayyiti mina alhayyi thalikumu Allahu faanna tufakoona: grain-splitting and life-death cycling as biological resurrection-metaphor accessible to agrarian observation.

evidence.excerpt: فَالِقُ ٱلۡإِصۡبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيۡلَ سَكَنٗا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ حُسۡبَانٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
evidence.rationale: Faliqu alisbahi wajaAAala allayla sakanan waalshshamsa waalqamara husbanan thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi: cosmic-order signs establishing regularity as divine determination not natural necessity.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهُ خَضِرٗا نُّخۡرِجُ مِنۡهُ حَبّٗا مُّتَرَاكِبٗا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخۡلِ مِن طَلۡعِهَا قِنۡوَانٞ دَانِيَةٞ وَجَنَّـٰتٖ مِّنۡ أَعۡنَابٖ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشۡتَبِهٗا وَغَيۡرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍۗ ٱنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثۡمَرَ وَيَنۡعِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكُمۡ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wahuwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi nabata kulli shayin...onthuroo ila thamarihi itha athmara wayanAAihi inna fee thalikum laayatin liqawmin yuminoona: vegetative catalogue with empirical observation-command directing attention to biodiversity as designed phenomenon.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَعَلُواْ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمۡۖ وَخَرَقُواْ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتِۭ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: WajaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa aljinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqoo lahu baneena wabanatin bighayri AAilmin subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yasifoona: jinn-partnership and offspring-fabrication condemned with tasbih-closure providing liturgical correction.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Multi-domain signs demonstrating comprehensive creative agency
Sign-observation leading to recognition of sole creator

candidates.urduLabel: الآيات البيئية والكونية الدالة على القدرة الإلهية: الله فالق الحب والنوى يخرج الحي من الميت ومخرج الميت من الحي؛ فالق الإصباح جعل الليل سكناً والشمس والقمر حسبانه؛ النجوم للاهتداء في ظلمات البر والبحر؛ نفس واحدة مستقر ومستودع؛ المطر يُخرج النبات والخضر والحب والنخل والعنب والزيتون والرمان انظروا إلى ثمره وينعه آيات للمؤمنين؛ سبحانه وتعالى عما يصفون
candidates.notes: Overlap with divine-power and tawheed. Faliq (cleaver) applied to both biological (grain) and cosmic (daybreak) domains unifying creative action. Life-death cycling provides empirical resurrection-proof preceding eschatological argument. Husbanan (calculation) frames celestial bodies as functional instruments not objects of worship. Single-soul origin establishes human unity preceding diversity. Vegetative catalogue moves from general (nabata kulli shayin) to specific (grape olive pomegranate) demonstrating taxonomic awareness. Onthuroo-command shifts burden to observer making sign-recognition active not passive. Tasbih-closure provides appropriate response to anthropomorphic fabrication.

candidates.label: Divine transcendence and vision-non-perception: Originator heavens earth no son no consort created everything Knower; no deity except Him Creator worship Disposer; vision perceives not He perceives vision Subtle Acquainted; insight from Lord sees for own soul blind upon it not guardian
candidates.definition: In 6:101-104: Originator of heavens and earth how could He have a son when He does not have a companion and He created all things and He is of all things Knowing. That is Allah your Lord no deity except Him Creator of all things so worship Him and He is Disposer of all things. Vision perceives Him not but He perceives vision and He is the Subtle the Acquainted. There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord so whoever sees does so for his own soul and whoever is blind does harm against it and I am not a guardian over you.

evidence.excerpt: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٞ وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٞۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: BadeeAAu alssamawati waalardi anna yakoonu lahu waladun walam takun lahu sahibatun wakhalaqa kulla shayin wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun: Badi'-originator excluding offspring through logical impossibility requiring consort.
